To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Chinese documents are very different from English ones and that the algorithms that work well for English documents do not work as efficiently for Chinese documents.
the English web search algorithms are not adaptable to Chinese search engines.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the adaptability of English based algorithms to Chinese documents.
the adaptation of well-known English web search algorithms to Chinese search engines.
the adaptability of English based search techniques to other languages.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
these algorithms are not adaptable to Chinese search engines.
the current state of Chinese web documents is too immature to be effectively and efficiently processed by current web search algorithms and techniques.
the current English web search algorithms are not adaptable to Chinese web search.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Chinese web search algorithms should be developed based on the Chinese web search characteristics.
Chinese web search is a unique problem that requires a different set of techniques to be developed and applied.
, in order for these algorithms to work effectively, the Chinese web search algorithms must be adapted to the unique characteristics of Chinese language and Chinese web documents.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the adaptability of these algorithms and techniques to other languages is not as simple and straightforward as it is often assumed.
the performance of these techniques are not satisfactory and they are not able to handle the complexity of Chinese documents and queries effectively.
the Chinese search algorithms need to be developed based on the characteristics of Chinese web documents.
